name: bpmn-flow
description: A modular, embeddable BPMN 2.0 workflow library: parse, execute and interactively visualize any BPMN process.
author: Bappoz

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bpmn-flow/core && npm run build -w @bpmn-flow/viewer && npm run build -w @bpmn-flow/server && npm run build -w @bpmn-flow/cli && npm run build -w @bpmn-flow/playground
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage
